title: LangChain Connection
description: Connect a LangChain-based agent for telemetry ingestion and lifecycle management.

apiEndpointUrl.title: API Endpoint URL
apiEndpointUrl.description: The base URL your LangChain agent's API is reachable at.

apiKey.title: API Key / Token
apiKey.description: Used to authenticate control-plane calls to your agent. Stored encrypted and never displayed again after this step.

langsmithProjectId.title: LangSmith Project ID
langsmithProjectId.description: Optional — associates this agent's traces with a LangSmith project for deeper debugging.

callbackUrl.title: Telemetry Callback URL
callbackUrl.description: Where AMS should deliver telemetry and health callbacks for this agent.

frameworkVersion.title: Framework Version
frameworkVersion.description: The LangChain version this agent runs — used to check adapter compatibility.
